native_mechanisms: A stone on a corner marks a distance as finally known and never reconsidered (permanently settled set).
A duck carries a spooled thread whose length is the running sum of road lengths to reach it (tentative distance label updated by edge relaxation).
Each round, the unstoned duck carrying the shortest thread is located and settled before any other duck moves (repeated global minimum extraction over tentative labels).
Roads into houses with no far side hang slack and are thrown away unspooled, never measured again (out-degree-0 vertices excluded from the selection structure).
core_technique: Standard Dijkstra with non-decreasing settle order, where extract-min is a two-level sqrt-decomposition (block-summary) SIMD linear scan over tentative keys instead of a heap, with a binary-heap Dijkstra fallback chosen by an n/m cost heuristic.
